full_judgment: AM Mahmudur Rahman J: By this application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure the petitioners impugned two orders relating to the appointment of Advocate Commissioner to examine the plaintiff. The opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 20 of 1994 in the court of Subordinate Judge, Jessore praying for decree for specific performance of contract for sale of schedule land of the plaint. The defendants, who are petitioners before this court, are contesting the suit by filing joint written statements denying material allegations and asserting that the agreement for sale is a forged and collusive document. The impugned order was made upon an application subsequently filed. Earlier another application was filed seeking such relief. Upon the previous application the trial Court by its order dated 12-11-95 directed the plaintiff to appear before the Court on 17-1-96. The plaintiff did not comply with such order but took adjournments. On 18-5-96 the plaintiff filed the subsequent application which has been allowed by the impugned order.
